title: Sonos Network Overview
description: SonosNet mesh health from the sonos-exporter: reachability, link quality, radio state, traffic and battery.

panels.title: Zones up
panels.description: Players reachable (ICMP when enabled, otherwise seen in the last scrape)

panels.title: Exporter scrape
panels.description: Result of the last /support/review fetch. FAILED means every other panel shows stale values.

panels.title: Data age
panels.description: Seconds since the last successful exporter scrape, as seen through the Prometheus scrape. Orange above 10 minutes.

panels.title: Weakest link per zone
panels.description: Lowest SonosNet FROM quality a zone has towards any peer, idle links with quality 0 ignored. Below 40 is a weak mesh link.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Seconds since the player booted. Orange when under a day, i.e. a recent reboot.

panels.title: Software versions
panels.description: More than one row means an update is pending or stuck somewhere

panels.title: Topology
panels.description: SonosNet mesh as reported by each player. Edge value is the FROM link quality, node is green when the player is up.

panels.title: Link asymmetry |FROM − TO|
panels.description: Large differences point to a one-sided problem such as interference near one player

panels.title: Wired & bridge
panels.description: Wired players are the roots of the SonosNet mesh

panels.title: Link quality matrix (avg of FROM/TO)
panels.description: One row per mesh link, colour is the average of FROM and TO quality over time. Red below 40, green above 55.

panels.title: WiFi mode
panels.description: One row per zone and mode. A zone that changes mode shows up as two rows.

panels.title: Playing (AUDIO_OUT)
panels.description: Set while the player outputs audio. The other busy flags (NO_PRIMARY, LOCAL_SONOSNET, ...) are static per zone and shown in the zone rows.

panels.title: PHY error rate
panels.description: PHY errors per second. The player resets its counter on every read, so this uses the exporter's accumulated sonos_radio_phy_errors_total. 15m window so it works with 5m scrapes.

panels.title: Bandwidth br0 (RX above, TX below zero)
Noise floor
panels.description: Average over RF chains. Only older Atheros based players (Play:1, Play:3, Play:5 gen 1, ...) report this.

panels.title: OFDM ANI level
panels.description: Adaptive noise immunity level of the Atheros radio. Higher means the radio is fighting interference. Only older players report this.

panels.title: Links from this zone
panels.description: Solid: FROM quality, dashed: TO quality
